messages:
Marta V (partnerships): Morning team 10am sync moved to accommodate vendor windows. Top goals: consolidate embargo dates, confirm marketable SKU names, and finalize SI integration owners. Drop quick updates.
Evan T (NVIDIA): NVIDIA update: H100/H200 GA timelines unchanged. H200 heat-mitigation patch will enter pilot 2025-10-05. We can share final spec doc by 2025-09-30.
Priya S (platform): Platform needs: exact device IDs and recommended kernel flags for heat management. Also request: vendor-provided perf knobs for MI300 that affect our autoscaler.
Omar H (eng-runtime): Runtime note: MI300 quantization path is stable on our CI for 512k sequence lengths. Gaudi support needs the latest Tenstella SDK; without it we see KV cache regressions.
Sophie R (product): We want to brand SKUs as: "redwood-h100-pro", "redwood-mi300-boost", and a working name for Gaudi "redwood-gaudi-preview" unless vendor prefers different naming. Need legal sign-off on names before embargo.
Evan T (NVIDIA): OK on H-series names. For Gaudi, Tenstella should weigh in. NVIDIA PR prefers partner names not include vendor trademarks.
Marta V (partnerships): Action: I'll ping Tenstella for naming. @Priya do we have a minimum artifact list we can send vendors to speed delivery?
Priya S (platform): Yes: AMI build + docker manifest, signed checksums, kernel compile flags, and brief runbook (2 pages). That should let us run staging certs.
Omar H (eng-runtime): Risk: if Tenstella SDK lags, Gaudi will be marked "preview" and gated from GA release. We should prepare a fallback of H100/H200/MI300 for the GA marketplace push.
Sophie R (product): Timeline proposal: internal canary for Wave1 (H100/MI300) on 2025-10-20; public GA 2025-11-10. Wave2 (Gaudi/B200) preview to follow once artifacts land. Thoughts?
Evan T (NVIDIA): Sounds reasonable. For B200, vendor firmware is still in validation, ETA uncertain. Suggest we avoid firm public dates for B200 until firmware checksum is delivered.
Marta V (partnerships): Draft DRI list:
- Tenstella: deliver SDK + AMI (due 2025-09-29)
- NVIDIA: heat patch spec (due 2025-09-30)
- Platform (Priya): staging manifest & gating flags (due 2025-10-03)
- Product (Sophie): release notes + naming legal check (due 2025-10-06)
I'll circulate and ask vendors to confirm.
Release-bot: Reminder scheduled: vendor roadmap sync 1: 2025-09-15 10:00:00 PT (auto-reminder 30m).
Priya S (platform): I'll add a marketplace feature toggle: "preview_gaudi" that can flip off for GA route. Will open RFC and stub PR by EOD.
Omar H (eng-runtime): Also adding a CI gate that fails the GA pipeline if firmware/checksum missing for B200. Keeps our SLAs clean.
Evan T (NVIDIA): We'll try to expedite B200 firmware, but keep the "preview" plan ready. I'll get the PR/press contact list by EOD.
Marta V (partnerships): Great. Last ask: vendors please provide embargo preferences (start/end) and a single comms owner so marketing can craft the copy. Thanks all.
